strings.浏览器本地运行 · 数据不上传 · 免安装: Runs in your browser · nothing uploaded · no installation
strings.{n} 个元启发式算法 × {n} 家族 × {n} 个可跑的问题页——每个算法: {n} metaheuristics × {n} families × {n} runnable problem pages — every algorithm page and every problem page has an online solver demo. Comparison charts for a paper, animations for a lecture, or just a look at how the algorithms really work: it is all here. Algorithms run in your browser (Pyodide, a Python engine for the browser; nothing to install) and no data is uploaded.
strings.首页即引擎的旗舰演示: The home page is the flagship demo of the engine
strings.实测锚点：n=100 城全算法同台（单 seed 教学对照，前十差距 <3% 统: Benchmark anchor: all algorithms on the same n=100 cities (one seed, for teaching; gaps under 3% among the top ten count as ties). Who leads, and by how much, is in the full results table and lineage map of the ▶ online demo; every experiment can be exported as an “experiment bundle” (data + algorithm source + re-run instructions) to re-run offline.
strings.进化/群智能/物理/人类/免疫/混合/多目标/新范式/隐喻批评区/专用求解对照系: Evolutionary / swarm / physics / human / immune / hybrid / multi-objective / new paradigms / metaphor criticism / dedicated-solver reference — every algorithm page has an online TSP solver, a dynamic parameter panel and notes on known pitfalls
strings.问题库 · {n} 页全求解化: Problem library · {n} pages, all solvable online
strings.0-1 背包及 10 变体 / 连续函数 / 多目标 / 图着色 5 变体 /: 0-1 knapsack and its 10 variants / continuous functions / multi-objective / graph colouring (5 variants) / bin packing (3 variants) / assignment and location / QUBO / SAT — a solver at the top of each page, with adjustable size
strings.3 分钟入门 · 百科总纲（问题分类四连问 × 七维度）· 交叉矩阵 X1-X4: 3-minute intro · encyclopedia overview (four questions for classifying problems × seven dimensions) · cross matrices X1–X4 · application map (96 blocks) · problem reductions (83-type spectrum)
strings.怎么用本站（三步）: How to use the site (three steps)
strings.零基础：先读三分钟入门，搞懂「元启发式」到底指什么、和精确算法什么关系。: New to this: read the three-minute intro first to see what a “metaheuristic” really is and how it relates to exact algorithms.
strings.动手跑：去 ▶ 在线演示跑一个 TSP 巡回（45 个算法可切换、调速、单步），: Run something: go to the ▶ online demo and run a TSP tour (switch between 45 algorithms, change speed, single-step), or open any problem page — the solver is at the top and the size parameters are yours to change.
strings.深入：按算法家族树或问题分类两侧翻；交叉矩阵把两轴连起来；覆盖矩阵看每个域能跑的: Go deeper: browse by the algorithm family tree or by problem classification; the cross matrix links the two axes; the coverage matrix shows every algorithm that runs in each domain; all demos export PNG / CSV and a reproducible result JSON for papers or teaching material; to use your own data, see Get started in 5 minutes.
strings.不必先懂算法——点开就跑，全程本地计算。: No need to understand the algorithms first — open and run; everything is computed locally.
strings.30/60/100 城实时路径动画 + 收敛曲线，45 算法可切换，支持导入自有: Live tour animation for 30/60/100 cities plus the convergence curve; 45 switchable algorithms; import your own data, export PNG/JSON
strings.同一批城市交给全站 45 个算法跑，曲线叠加、结果排名一次出，可导出 CSV: Give the same cities to all 45 algorithms: overlaid curves and a ranked table in one go, exportable as CSV
strings.元启发式不只解 TSP——同一批算法，换编码就能换问题域。下面六个演示覆盖了变量: Metaheuristics do not only solve TSP — the same algorithms reach other problem domains just by changing the encoding. The six demos below cover the main kinds of variables; the status of all 20 domains is in the coverage matrix, and the classification method is in the encyclopedia overview.
strings.PSO/DE/GWO 的原生域：地形热力图+粒子动画，Sphere/Rastri: The native domain of PSO/DE/GWO: landscape heat map plus particle animation — Sphere, Rastrigin, Rosenbrock, Ackley
strings.二进制编码+贪心修复算子，{n} 种算法同台: Binary encoding + greedy repair operator, {n} algorithms side by side
strings.NSGA-II 前沿动画 vs 加权法坍缩的活对照: A live contrast: the NSGA-II front animation versus the collapse of the weighted-sum method
strings.排列编码换解码器：染色动画 + DSJC 硬实例，色数阶梯下降: Permutation encoding with a swappable decoder: colouring animation + hard DSJC instances, colour count stepping down
strings.排列编码三连演：装箱动画 + 下界 LB 对照，触 LB 即最优: Permutation encoding, three-in-one: bin-packing animation compared with the lower bound LB — reaching LB means optimal
strings.QAP·GAP·MCLP·p-中位·充电站·急救车——把「谁放哪」讲成一族问题: QAP · GAP · MCLP · p-median · charging stations · ambulances — “who goes where” explained as one family of problems
strings.xᵀQx 统一约束通向量子退火生态；SAT 竞赛与演化密码学: xᵀQx unifies constraints and leads into the quantum-annealing ecosystem; SAT competitions and evolutionary cryptography
strings.家族×问题 SOTA · 编码 · 算子 · 本站实测——两轴之间的桥: Family × problem state of the art · encodings · operators · measurements on this site — the bridge between the two axes
strings.96 应用块 · 问题形态 9 类 ⇄ 行业 13 类双视图导航：电力/制造/医: 96 application blocks · two-way navigation between 9 problem shapes and 13 industries: power, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, aerospace… an index only, kept compact
strings.什么问题能变成什么问题：归约·等价·特例·推广，每条带原始文献出处: What reduces to what: reductions, equivalences, special cases and generalisations, each with its original reference
strings.问题分类四连问 × 七个正交维度 × 覆盖矩阵 × 术语表: Four questions for classifying problems × seven orthogonal dimensions × coverage matrix × glossary
strings.给做优化方向的同学一个能直接跑、能截图、能对比的地方：写论文要对比实验图、上课要: A place where people working on optimisation can run things directly, take screenshots and compare: comparison charts for a paper, animations for a class, or simply a look at how these algorithms work. Everything runs in the browser, the code is open and readable, and the pitfalls of each algorithm are written down in the source comments.
strings.算法在浏览器本地运行（Pyodide + Web Worker），不上传任何数据: Algorithms run locally in the browser (Pyodide + Web Worker), nothing is uploaded, and you can import your own datasets (JSON / CSV / TXT)
strings.日夜双主题、暂停、单步、调速、采样间隔（每 1/2/5/10 代取一点）、导出: Light and dark themes, pause, single-step, speed control, sampling interval (one point every 1/2/5/10 generations), and PNG export ready for a paper or slides
strings.参数面板动态生成，改一个算法的参数不需要改任何前端代码: The parameter panel is generated dynamically — changing an algorithm's parameters needs no front-end code
strings.Pyodide + Web Worker · 源码与实现细节见项目 README: Pyodide + Web Worker · see the project README for source and implementation details
strings.这个站不只是介绍算法：{n} 个算法都能在浏览器里直接跑，你还可以换成自己的数据: This site is not only descriptions of algorithms: all {n} algorithms run directly in your browser, and you can swap in your own data, export the result and let others reproduce it. Everything is computed on your own computer and no data is uploaded anywhere.
strings.打开 ▶ 演示，等页面顶部状态变成「引擎就绪」（第一次要下载约 13 MB 的浏: Open ▶ Demo and wait until the status at the top reads “Engine ready” (the first time it downloads about 13 MB of in-browser Python, so give it a few seconds).
strings.在「算法」里挑一个（比如粒子群、蚁群、遗传算法），点「开始」。左边是路线在一代代: Pick one under “Algorithm” (for example particle swarm, ant colony or genetic algorithm) and press “Start”. On the left the route gets shorter generation by generation; on the right is the convergence curve.
strings.想一步一步看就点「单步」；想换一批随机城市点「换一批城市」。: Press “Step” to go one generation at a time, or “New cities” for a fresh random set.
strings.打不开或一直「初始化中」？本站必须通过 http 访问（不能双击打开本地文件），: Won't open, or stuck on “Initialising…”? The site must be accessed over http (it cannot be opened by double-clicking a local file), and the browser must be Chrome / Edge 111+, Firefox 114+ or Safari 16.4+. The reason is shown at the top of the page.
strings.第 2 步 · 换成你自己的数据（2 分钟）: Step 2 · Use your own data (2 minutes)
strings.不同问题的数据长得不一样，但入口一致：点页面上的「导入数据 / 导入实例」，选文: Data looks different for different problems, but the entry point is the same: press “Import data / Import instance” on the page and choose a file. The file is validated first, and any error is pointed out at the exact place (for example “items[3][0]: must be greater than 0”), so nothing is silently misread.
strings.旅行商（TSP）：演示页「导入数据」。支持坐标（JSON 或每行 x,y 的 C: Travelling salesman (TSP): “Import data” on the demo page. Supports coordinates (JSON, or CSV with one x,y per line, optionally with an ID column), standard TSPLIB .tsp files, and symmetric distance matrices. 4–500 cities.
strings.背包、装箱、图着色、可满足性、QUBO、集合覆盖、指派、设施选址、连续函数、多目: Knapsack, bin packing, graph colouring, satisfiability, QUBO, set cover, assignment, facility location, continuous functions, multi-objective…: go to the matching page under Problems and press “Import instance”. Every page has a downloadable sample file; edit it into your own data.
strings.本站没有的问题：到 自带问题，选一种解的形状（是/否、排序、实数），写一个目标函: A problem this site does not have: go to Bring your own problem, choose a solution shape (yes/no, ordering, real numbers) and write an objective function; dozens of ready-made algorithms work immediately. See the guide to custom problems for how to write it.
strings.所有格式和每个字段的含义见: All formats and the meaning of every field are in the
strings.看清「保真度」：问题页顶部的徽标说明这个模型有多贴近教科书定义——「标准」可以和: Read the “fidelity” label: the badge at the top of a problem page says how close the model is to the textbook definition — “standard” can be compared with the literature; “simplified for teaching” and “illustrative” only borrow the problem's name to show its shape, so do not take the results as conclusions about that problem. The same notice appears when you import data.
strings.第 3 步 · 导出可复现的结果（1 分钟）: Step 3 · Export a reproducible result (1 minute)
strings.运行结束后点「结果 JSON」（问题页是「导出结果」）。得到的文件里包含：完整实: When a run finishes, press “Result JSON” (on problem pages: “Export result”). The file contains the full instance, algorithm, random seed, parameters, per-generation convergence curve and the best solution. Send it to others or keep it for the record; later it can be reproduced and checked on any computer with Python:
strings.输出「复现成功」说明同样的输入得到了逐点相同的曲线。格式见 结果文件格式。: “Reproduction successful” means the same input gave a point-for-point identical curve. See the result file format.
strings.不想开浏览器？用命令行: Prefer no browser? Use the command line
strings.只需要 Python 3.8+，不用装任何包（在项目目录里）：: All you need is Python 3.8+, no packages (run in the project folder):
strings.结果怎么看才不容易误会: How to read the results without being misled
strings.页面上的对比表是单个随机种子、单个实例的结果，换个种子名次可能就变了。要下结论，: The comparison tables on the pages are the result of a single random seed and a single instance; with another seed the ranking can change. Before drawing a conclusion, try several seeds and several instances.
strings.「最优」是这个算法这次找到的最好解，不是数学上证明的最优。: “Best” means the best solution this algorithm found in this run — it is not mathematically proven optimal.
strings.浏览器里的 Python 比本机慢约 2 倍。实例很大时，页面会估算「预计还需多: Python in the browser is about 2× slower than native. On large instances the page estimates the time remaining; if a single step takes too long a “Force stop and reload engine” button appears.
